title: Amy Nixon comments on recent negative news about Frisco and local housing policy
text:
Amy Nixon, a commentator on social media, has recently posted several tweets drawing attention to events in Frisco, Texas and issues surrounding local governance.
On February 17, 2026, Nixon highlighted concerns about recent news coverage involving Frisco. She wrote: “Every time Frisco, TX has been in the news recently, it hasn’t been good… This is an ELEMENTARY SCHOOL. The kids are ages 5-11 https://t.co/ekcQqQxPd1”.
The following day, on February 18, 2026, Nixon posted a brief tweet referencing another incident or topic with: ” https://t.co/sYefhPzJXq”.
Later that same day, she commented on political leadership and housing policy by stating: “This is a guy who campaigned on housing affordability https://t.co/0mmzlM6gQ9”.
Frisco has experienced increased scrutiny in regional news due to incidents involving its public schools and ongoing debates over housing affordability. These topics have drawn commentary from residents and observers alike as the city continues to grow rapidly within the Dallas-Fort Worth metropolitan area.
